metadata.title: Mid-Century Rock and Roll Album Cover

retrievalProfile.description: A mid-century album cover featuring a low-angle outdoor portrait of a musician with a hollow-body guitar, utilizing stacked sans-serif and serif typography with high-contrast outlines.

recipe.visualDefinition: A square composition featuring a musician in a white knit sweater playing a red hollow-body guitar against a rocky desert backdrop. The layout uses a mix of bold, condensed sans-serif titles at the top and elegant, outlined serif display text on the left, all set against a bright, slightly overexposed sky.
coreVisualRelationships: Musician and guitar as the primary focal point in the lower two-thirds
Text blocks anchored to the top and left margins
Warm red of the guitar contrasting with the cool blue sky and white sweater
Rugged rock textures framing the subject on the right
coreInvariants: Low-angle perspective looking up at the musician
High-contrast drop shadows or outlines on all display typography
Bright, washed-out sky background providing negative space for text

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The musician is positioned centrally and slightly to the right, occupying the lower 70% of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The red hollow-body guitar serves as the primary visual anchor due to its color and central placement.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the bold top title, moves down to the artist name on the left, and follows the guitar neck to the musician's face.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The upper left quadrant consists of a bright, pale sky, providing a clean area for secondary text.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Pale blue and white (sky and sweater) providing a bright foundation.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep browns and shadows in the rocks and musician's hair.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant red of the guitar and orange-yellow of the top title text.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value (brightness) in the background with saturated accents in the foreground elements.
paletteRestrictions: Limited to warm earth tones, primary red, and sky blue

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Mix of condensed grotesque sans-serif and high-contrast transitional serifs.
letterConstructionRules: Top title uses heavy vertical compression and thick outlines
Artist name uses wide, elegant serifs with thin internal outlines
Secondary text uses clean, all-caps sans-serif
characterSpecificRedesigns: Quotation marks are stylized as thick, slanted blocks
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-impact condensed sans-serif for the hook paired with elegant, airy serifs for the name.
graphicDevices: Text outlines for legibility against bright backgrounds

preserve: The contrast between the condensed top font and the wide middle font
The use of outlines on the text

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the condensed, heavy feel of the top title
Provides the classic high-contrast serif look for the artist name

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a low-angle photograph of a man in a white 1950s knit sweater playing a red hollow-body electric guitar. He is sitting against a backdrop of jagged brown rocks and a bright, clear, slightly overexposed blue sky. The lighting should be bright daylight.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a bold, condensed sans-serif title in orange with a red outline at the top. Add the artist's name in a wide, outlined serif font in the middle left. Add a small rectangular logo box in the top right corner.

verificationChecks: Is the guitar a red hollow-body style?
Is the top text condensed and outlined?
Is the background sky bright enough to make the text legible?
Is the perspective a low-angle shot?

adjustableVariables: Specific typeface for the artist name
mustRedesign: Modern guitar models like solid-body electrics

mustAchieve: Authentic 1950s film grain and color saturation

postGenerationChecks: Check that the text does not obscure the musician's face
Ensure the red of the guitar is the most saturated element
Verify the knit texture of the sweater is visible
Confirm the typography feels integrated into the 1950s era
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a low-angle outdoor musician portrait with a split typographic hierarchy: heavy condensed headers at the top and elegant outlined serifs for the subject name.
